title: Dusty and Sweets McGee (IB Tech Print)             / Born to Win
description: Meet Tip, Pam, Larry, Kit, Dusty, Sweets McGee and nameless, aimless more with young faces and old eyes. Meet them, but don’t get too attached. Because tomorrow some of them may not be alive. Most of the people who appear in his astonishing semi-documentary about the daily life of Los Angeles heroin abusers are real-life addicts, caught up in an endless cycle of stealing, hustling, jail time, shooting up, and coming down. Realistic and unapologetic, the film includes only a handful of actors, including Billy Grey ( Father Knows Best ) portraying a street-smart drug dealer. Directed by Floyd Mutrux ( American Hot Wax ), with graphic cinematography by William A. Fraker ( Bullitt ), Dusty and Sweets McGee is “a film in its own category. There are long stretches during which it’s hard to take your eyes off the screen” (Mick LaSalle, San Francisco Chronicle ). (Warner Bros)

title: Network
description: I’m mad as Hell and I’m not going to take it anymore! One of the greatest satiric thrillers of all time, Sidney Lumet’s paranoid masterpiece Network has never stopped being relevant in an ever-increasingly corporate world. The UBS network is ready to retire their anchorman Howard Beale after 25 years. In an on-air tirade, Beale announces his plan to kill himself on TV. When ratings sky-rocket, Beale’s angry prophet routine becomes big business, and UBS decides to go even harder into extreme programming. Savagely funny, soul-shatteringly prescient, and with unbelievable performances from Peter Finch and Faye Dunaway, it’s easy to see how this film won 4 Oscars and continues to stay timely – 50 years later.

title: LOVE IN THE AFTERNOON
description: Though happily married to his adoring wife Hélène, with whom he is expecting a second child, the thoroughly bourgeois business executive Frédéric cannot banish from his mind the multitude of attractive Parisian women who pass him by every day. His flirtations and fantasies remain harmless until Chloé (played by the mesmerizing Zouzou), an audacious, unencumbered old flame, shows up at his office, embodying the first genuine threat to Frédéric’s marriage. The luminous final chapter to Rohmer’s “Moral Tales” is a tender, sobering, and wholly adult affair that leads to perhaps the most overwhelmingly emotional moment in the entire series.

title: American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
description: Against political resistance and industry skepticism, Luis Valdez pushes Chicano storytelling from the fields to the film screen with Zoot Suit and La Bamba , crafting iconic works that challenge, celebrate, and expand America’s story.

description: At 11:30pm on October 11, 1975, a ferocious troupe of young comedians and writers changed television – and culture – forever. Directed by Jason Reitman and written by Gil Kenan & Reitman, Saturday Night is based on the true story of what happened behind the scenes in the 90 minutes leading up to the first broadcast of Saturday Night Live. Full of humor, chaos, and the magic of a revolution that almost wasn’t, we count down the minutes in real time until we hear those famous words…

title: Jackie Brown
description: A stewardess, a gun runner, a bail bondsman, a federal agent, an ex-con and a stoned-out beach bunny are all on the trail of half-million dollars in Quentin Tarantino’s Jackie Brown , a mesmerizing, all-star adaptation of Elmore Leonard’s novel Rum Punch . But who’s getting played and who’s gonna make the big score?

title: PICNIC AT HANGING ROCK
description: In the early 1900s, Miranda (Anne Lambert) attends a girls boarding school in Australia. One Valentine’s Day, the school’s typically strict headmistress (Rachel Roberts) treats the girls to a picnic field trip to an unusual but scenic volcanic formation called Hanging Rock. Despite rules against it, Miranda and several other girls venture off. It’s not until the end of the day that the faculty realizes the girls and one of the teachers (Vivean Gray) have disappeared mysteriously.

title: The Thing
description: As the temperature rises, join us in the air conditioning for a chilling trip to Antarctica with one of the best horror/sci-fi films ever made. At a remote Antarctica outpost, a research team of misfits and malcontents comes under attack by a shape-shifting alien lifeform that had been trapped in the ice for 100,000 years. As the creature rages through the men, assuming one identity after another, the paranoia rises as the temperatures outside plummet. A fantastic cast, lead by the never-better Kurt Russell, amazing, now-legendary practical effects, and John Carpenter’s atmospheric direction make The Thing a chilling classic.

title: Forastera
description: Join us in our microcinema for the haunted Spanish vacation your summer was missing with this tender and otherworldly film of loss, ghosts, and grief from filmmaker Lucía Aleñar Iglesias. Cata will see her summer vacation disrupted by the absurd and sudden death of her grandmother, which only she witnesses. Her grief shifts when she casually turns to play pretend, transforming into the deceased. What begins with a game of dress-up will blur the lines of reality and family roles. With absolutely stunning cinematography (with an incredible use of framing), the exquisite backdrop of the Catalonian coastline, and a breathy and ethereal vibe, this is one of the loveliest ghost stories you may ever see.

title: ONE NIGHT ONLY
description: Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

title: TONY
description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

title: Psycho
description: Join us for a full day of killer films that inspired Jane Schoenbrun’s Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma presented by our friends at MUBI.

title: Stranger Than Paradise
description: Rootless Hungarian émigré Willie (John Lurie), his pal Eddie (Richard Edson), and visiting sixteen-year-old cousin Eva (Eszter Balint) always manage to make the least of any situation, whether aimlessly traversing the drab interiors and environs of New York City, Cleveland, or an anonymous Florida suburb. With its delicate humor and dramatic nonchalance, Jim Jarmusch’s one-of-a-kind minimalist masterpiece, _Stranger Than Paradise_, forever transformed the landscape of American independent cinema.

title: Green Border with Agnieszka Holland
description: Winner of the Special Jury Prize at the 2023 Venice Film Festival, Holland’s “angry and urgent masterpiece” ( The Guardian ) centers around the 2021 migrant crisis that unfolded in the exclusion zone between Poland and Belarus. Named for the swamplands that cover the region, Holland’s impactful narrative was conceived by reflecting on actual events, using interviews with real border guards and refugees to inform the four interwoven stories that supply the work with its incredible emotional depth. Made with trusted collaborators, including cinematographer Tomasz Naumiuk and co-writer Gabriela Łazarkiewicz-Sieczko, Green Border insists on depicting regional upheaval and conflict by prioritizing its human impact.
director: Agnieszka Holland PRODUCED BY: Fred Bernstein, Agnieszka Holland, Marcin Wierzchoslawski

title: Doughboys Present RAISING CAIN
description: Hosts and longtime frenemies Mike Mitchell and Nick Wiger review chain restaurants and bicker about absolutely everything on the iHeartRadio award-winning Best Food Podcast, Doughboys .

title: Twin Peaks: The Original Mystery – Episodes 5 + 6
description: She’s dead… wrapped in plastic. If your summer plans call for an enigmatic journey to the Pacific Northwest and a small sleepy burg called Twin Peaks , have we got news for you! Go back to the beginning of David Lynch and Mark Frost’s game-changing television phenomenon with a special theatrical screening of the first two episodes of this landmark series on our beautiful big screen. When the homecoming queen washes ashore shrouded in a plastic coccoon, this small town is thrown into tragedy and panic. Luckily, the FBI’s most intriguing special agent, Dale Cooper, is on the case and vows to unravel this enduring mystery that extends beyond Twin Peaks and into the dark recesses of this universe and beyond. Whether you’re starting the show for the first time, or you’re revisiting for your twentieth, there’s nothing like seeing this dark, clever, mystical, metaphysical, and offbeat masterpiece at Vidiots!

title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit?
description: Eddie Valiant (Bob Hoskins), a private eye in 1930s Los Angeles, gets an unexpected client—Roger Rabbit, a cartoon film star. Director Robert Zemeckis’s witty comedy-mystery is a dazzling mix of live-action and animation, incorporating beloved cartoon characters from Disney and other studios. Nominated for its art direction, cinematography, and sound, it won for its film editing, sound effects editing, and visual effects. Richard Williams also received a Special Achievement Award from the Academy for his animation direction.

description: At 11:30pm on October 11, 1975, a ferocious troupe of young comedians and writers changed television – and culture – forever. Directed by Jason Reitman and written by Gil Kenan & Reitman, Saturday Night is based on the true story of what happened behind the scenes in the 90 minutes leading up to the first broadcast of Saturday Night Live. title: Dredd
description: In a hyper-violent dystopic metropolis, an elite law enforcement group acts as judge, jury, and executioner. And when veteran officer Judge Dredd (Karl Urban) and his young recruit (Olivia Thirlby) arrive at a 200-storey tower block to investigate a murder, they’ll find themselves in a ruthless battle with a vicious drug kingpin (Lena Headey) and her seemingly endless army of killers. Screenwriter Alex Garland adapts the legendary comic.

title: Honey, I Shrunk the Kids
description: Rick Moranis is nobody’s Father of the Year as he takes science one step too far and miniaturizes his whole family. The scientist father of a teenage girl and boy accidentally shrinks his and two other neighborhood teens to the size of insects. Now the teens must fight diminutive dangers as the father searches for them. A microscopic adventure to share with the whole family!

title: IT'S A MAD, MAD, MAD, MAD WORLD in 70mm
description: Milton Berle, Sid Caesar and Jimmy Durante are just a few of the stars that shine in this laugh-out-loud adventure about a goofy assortment of vacationing motorists who compete to locate a stolen fortune.

title: DAUGHTERS, WIVES AND A MOTHER
description: A prestige talent showcase for Toho, led by the venerable Aiko Mimasu alongside Setsuko Hara and Hideko Takamine, and supported by a dozen further major and minor stars of the era, Naruse’s full color melodrama is a feat of directorial command, never once buckling under its own widescreen weight. Concerning the ill fortunes of a widowed mother (Mimasu) and her five adult children as they endure a string of destabilizing personal and financial shocks, this melancholy picture of a Japanese family’s gradual disintegration evokes Naruse’s friend and critical rival Ozu with its succession of domestic rearrangements and tests of filial responsibility. Small wonder that Ozu favorite Chishu Ryu makes an eleventh hour cameo.

title: Whisper of the Heart (English Dubbed Version)
description: An animated coming of age classic from the beloved Studio Ghibli, featuring a funny, heartfelt screenplay by Hayao Miyazaki based on the original manga by Aoi Hiiragi. When a quiet, creative girl with dreams of becoming a writer looks carefully through her library books, she discovers they were all checked out previously by the same person, leading her on a life-changing quest that unlocks her talent & potential. Take Me Home, Country Roads.

title: Franz with Agnieszka Holland
description: Based on the life of German-speaking Jewish-Czech modernist author Franz Kafka, who died in 1924 at 40 after publishing three novels and a handful of short stories and parables, Franz was a natural story for Holland to adapt into a film: she read his famous Metamorphosis when she was 14 and felt “since that time, Kafka is my brother” ( Screen Daily ). Wanting to give the character “light—and some punk infusion,” Holland takes a playful approach to the author’s idiosyncratic personality through “some kind of biography” that she hopes appeals to young people who might not be familiar with this man who has been written about far more voluminously than he was able to write for himself.
director: Agnieszka Holland PRODUCED BY: Šárka Cimbalová, Agnieszka Holland

title: Funny Girl
description: Hello Gorgeous! There’s no better time to revel in the glory of Barbra than in her Oscar-winning performance in William Wyler’s masterful musical biopic Funny Girl ! In this bittersweet, iconic musical classic, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on the Great White Way with help from theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld while struggling with her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif). Nominated for eight Academy Awards and considered one of the best musicals of all time – be one of the luckiest people in the world and don’t miss Streisand in her full glory on our big screen and blasted in stereo!

title: EARTH GIRLS ARE EASY
description: Prior to the screening, visit Angelyne’s pink corvette outside of the theatre where Angelyne merch will be available for purchase.

title: Poultrygeist: Night of the Chicken Dead + Tromeo & Juliet
description: Brain Dead Studios presents TROMA — a double feature celebrating two of Troma’s most depraved cult classics.

title: Throw Momma from the Train             / Ruthless People
description: Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal star in a black comedy riff on Hitchcock’s Strangers on a Train ! Crystal plays a newly divorced sad sack bitter that his ex-wife stole his novel and turned it into her own bestseller. DeVito is the long-suffering momma’s boy eager to get out from his mother’s thumb. But when one suggests trading murders as the perfect alibi, the foul play will spin hilariously out of control. DeVito directs his first theatrical feature film, while director of photography Barry Sonnenfeld adds a stylish & energetic verve to the proceedings (the same year he also helmed Raising Arizona ). Plus, Anne Ramsey is unforgettable as DeVito’s domineering mother.

title: SINNERS in 70mm
description: From Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Ryan Coogler, SINNERS is a genre-bending and multi-layered exploration of Black culture and the Blues music that is unique to it, told through the lens of a Southern Gothic epic. Set in 1932 Mississippi, Michael B. Jordan stars as twin brothers Smoke and Stack, who, after chasing success in the North, return to Clarksdale, Mississippi to open a juke joint and revive the soul and spirit of their hometown. As music and dance meld in celebration of artistry, culture and history, an evil descends, threatening to devour the fabric and heart of the community — and all that Smoke and Stack have worked to achieve. Uniquely shot on both Ultra Panavision 70 and IMAX 70mm, SINNERS is a singular and emotionally resonant tale of cultural change that resonates still today.

title: The Truman Show
description: Grab the remote and change the station – it’s time for The Truman Show on our big beautiful screen. Jim Carrey plays America’s favorite reality star, only he doesn’t know how and when he signed up for the airtime! In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show. A smart, funny, and endearing satire of celebrity culture and reality television with a killer cast and a soundtrack that includes tons of Phillip Glass, Peter Weir’s modern classic remains perennially relevant and rewatch-worthy.

title: Europa Europa with Agnieszka Holland
description: Inspired by the memoirs of Solomon Perel, a German Jew who evaded Nazi persecution by joining their ranks, Holland’s WWII–era biopic offers "new immediacy to the outrage by locating specific, wrenching details that transcend cliché" ( New York Times ). Nominated for Best Adapted Screenplay at the 64th Oscars—the film was shut out of the then-named Foreign Language Film category when Germany refused to nominate it for its thematic content—Holland’s complicated work investigates ways that denial and untruths can lead to irrepressible personal, generational, and cultural anguish.

title: Yes, Madam!
description: The iconic Michelle Yeoh teams up with the incredibly bad ass Cynthia Rothrock for one riotously fun martial arts action spectacular from Hong Kong legend Corey Yuen! Two unlucky thieves break into a just murdered man’s hotel room and steal his passport, with a hidden microfilm, wanted by a triad boss. Two ass-kicking women cops—one Chinese, one British—are on the case. A universally beloved action comedy with two of the coolest ladies of all time, this is going to be one hell of a Saturday night!

title: THE FALL
description: In silent-era Hollywood, stuntman Roy Walker (Lee Pace) is brought to a hospital after an on-set accident. There, he befriends a young girl (Catinca Untaru) and tells her a fantastical tale of epic heroes taking revenge on an evil ruler. The story transports her from the hospital into the exotic landscapes of her imagination.

title: Korczak with Agnieszka Holland
description: Just after Agnieszka Holland completed film school in Prague, Polish filmmaker Andrzej Wajda, already an established and celebrated auteur for films like Ashes and Diamonds (1958), welcomed the young aspirant to visit his set of The Wedding (1973). Over time, Holland said, “our relation moved from ‘master–pupil’ to something much more equal in collaboration and friendship,” and she started to write scripts with him. One of their most meaningful collaborations was this 1990 biopic about the extraordinary Polish-Jewish humanitarian Janusz Korczak, remembered “for his pedagogical philosophy and his heroic actions during the Holocaust,” Holland told the BFI. With stunning cinematography by Robby Müller ( Dead Man , 1995), Korczak is, as Steven Spielberg once wrote, "one of the most important European pictures about the Holocaust."
director: Andrzej Wajda PRODUCED BY: Janusz Morgenstern, Willi Segler, Daniel Toscan du Plantier, Regina Ziegler

title: Doug Jones Presents CREATURE FROM THE BLACK LAGOON 3D
description: A group of scientists on the hunt for fossilized evidence of aquatic creatures in the Amazon get more than they bargained for when a mysterious “Gill-man” starts terrorizing the expedition. While the men chase after this strange new discovery, the beautiful Kay Lawrence (Julia Adams) in thrown into grave peril.

title: One Hundred and One Dalmatians
description: What’s better than one puppy? Over one hundred puppies of course! And who would ever want to hurt dozens of puppies? An evil fashionista named Cruella De Vil that’s who. But the four-legged parents of these adorable spotted babies aren’t going to let the villainess or her criminal henchmen make off with their precious furballs. Bring your own adorable litter of little ones and relish this furry fable all over again!
director: Clyde Geronimi, Hamilton Luske, Wolfgang Reitherman

title: Out of Africa
description: The memoir of Danish author Karen Blixen (published under her pen name Isak Dinesen) was adapted by director Sydney Pollack and screenwriter Kurt Leudtke for this lavish romantic drama, focusing on the years Blixen (Best Actress nominee Meryl Streep) spent running a coffee farm in Nairobi and her relationship with hunter Denys Finch-Hatton (Robert Redford). Out of Africa was nominated for 11 Oscars and won seven including Best Picture, Directing (both for Pollack), Adapted Screenplay, Art Direction, Cinematography and Sound, with John Barry winning his fourth Oscar for an achingly romantic score.

description: The legendary true-story of Capt. Richard Francis Burton and Lt. John Hanning Speke’s tumultuous expedition to find the source of the Nile River.

title: ADIEU BONAPARTE
description: connection centers on Napoleon’s occupation of Egypt at the turn of the nineteenth century and the complex relationship that develops between two Arab brothers (Mohsen Mohieddin and Mohamad Atef) and the gay French general Cafarelli (Michel Piccoli, playing one of many fascinating queer characters populating Chahine’s films).

title: Persepolis
description: Vidiots remembers the life, legacy, and creativity of the extraordinary Marjane Satrapi with a special screening of the animated masterpiece Persepolis!

title: Forastera
description: Join us in our microcinema for the haunted Spanish vacation your summer was missing with this tender and otherworldly film of loss, ghosts, and grief from filmmaker Lucía Aleñar Iglesias. Cata will see her summer vacation disrupted by the absurd and sudden death of her grandmother, which only she witnesses. Her grief shifts when she casually turns to play pretend, transforming into the deceased. What begins with a game of dress-up will blur the lines of reality and family roles. With absolutely stunning cinematography (with an incredible use of framing), the exquisite backdrop of the Catalonian coastline, and a breathy and ethereal vibe, this is one of the loveliest ghost stories you may ever see.

title: La Haine
description: In a world of black and white, there is only color, and for friends Vinz (Vincent Cassel) , Hubert (Hubert Koundé), and Saïd (Saïd Taghmaoui) — that color is blue. Armed with a gun, the trio set out on a 24-hour trek through the banlieue districts of Paris in the wake of a clash with the authorities which has left one man in the hospital and three hurtling towards an explosive conclusion. Shot with the idea that the” film should be banned,” Mathieu Kassovitz’s no-holds-barred look of France in the grip of racial tension and fear caused a sensation upon release, and later became an international arthouse smash and a landmark of modern French cinema. Is Paris burning? You bet.

title: The Odyssey (70mm)
description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

title: Throw Momma from the Train             / Ruthless People
description: Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal star in a black comedy riff on Hitchcock’s Strangers on a Train ! Crystal plays a newly divorced sad sack bitter that his ex-wife stole his novel and turned it into her own bestseller. DeVito is the long-suffering momma’s boy eager to get out from his mother’s thumb. But when one suggests trading murders as the perfect alibi, the foul play will spin hilariously out of control. DeVito directs his first theatrical feature film, while director of photography Barry Sonnenfeld adds a stylish & energetic verve to the proceedings (the same year he also helmed Raising Arizona ). Plus, Anne Ramsey is unforgettable as DeVito’s domineering mother.

title: MAGNIFICENT OBSESSION
description: Reckless rich playboy, played by the great Rock Hudson in his breakthrough role, commits maritime manslaughter that ends the life of the town’s beloved local doctor. Douglas Sirk’s delirious Technicolor melodrama weaves its way through wild twists, turns, trials, tribulations, the American subconscious and the sudsy and spiritual journey to make right what can never be undone.

title: RAMBO: FIRST BLOOD PART II in 70mm
description: John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is released from prison to carry out a top secret mission rescuing POWs held in the jungles of Vietnam.

title: Miller’s Crossing
description: Co-presented by our friends at American Cinema Editors and featuring a conversation with editor Michael Miller moderated by John Venzon . Also featuring a book signing of Miller’s book Developing the Editor’s Eye .

description: THE ODYSSEY is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to screens for the first time and opens in cinemas everywhere July 17, 2026. The film stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong’o, Samantha Morton, Zendaya, and Charlize Theron. THE ODYSSEY is produced by Thomas and Nolan for their company, Syncopy, and is executive produced by Thomas Hayslip. Nolan’s most recent film, 2023’s OPPENHEIMER, earned seven Academy Awards including Best Picture and Best Director.

title: Twin Peaks: The Original Mystery – Episodes 3 + 4
description: She’s dead… wrapped in plastic. If your summer plans call for an enigmatic journey to the Pacific Northwest and a small sleepy burg called Twin Peaks , have we got news for you! Go back to the beginning of David Lynch and Mark Frost’s game-changing television phenomenon with a special theatrical screening of the first two episodes of this landmark series on our beautiful big screen. When the homecoming queen washes ashore shrouded in a plastic coccoon, this small town is thrown into tragedy and panic. Luckily, the FBI’s most intriguing special agent, Dale Cooper, is on the case and vows to unravel this enduring mystery that extends beyond Twin Peaks and into the dark recesses of this universe and beyond. Whether you’re starting the show for the first time, or you’re revisiting for your twentieth, there’s nothing like seeing this dark, clever, mystical, metaphysical, and offbeat masterpiece at Vidiots!

title: CLAIRE'S KNEE
description: “Why would I tie myself to one woman if I were interested in others?” says Jerôme, even as he plans on marrying a diplomat’s daughter by summer’s end. Before then, Jerôme spends his July at a lakeside boardinghouse nursing crushes on the sixteen-year-old Laura and, more tantalizingly, Laura’s long-legged, blonde stepsister, Claire. Baring her knee on a ladder under a blooming cherry tree, Claire unwittingly instigates Jerôme’s moral crisis and creates both one of French cinema’s most enduring moments and what has become the iconic image of Rohmer’s Moral Tales.

title: The Cat Returns
description: A spin-off of Whisper of the Heart, The Cat Returns finds another schoolgirl encountering a mysterious tomcat on the street, though this time she is led to a fantastic world beyond her wildest dreams. Launched into a cobblestoned magic kingdom ruled by cat royalty—including a motorcade replete with vassals, maidens, and even Secret Service—she must enlist the help of the elusive Baron Humbert von Gikkingen (the same cat featured as a statue in Whisper of the Heart) if she hopes to make it back home. The only feature film directed by Hiroyuki Morita to date, The Cat Returns is a feline flight of fancy.

title: Cinematic Void Presents SUBURBIA
description: The narrative directorial debut of Penelope Spheeris (WAYNE’S WORLD, THE DECLINE OF WESTERN CIVILIZATION), SUBURBIA will kick your ass. Made for Roger Corman’s New World Pictures after Spheeris’ phenomenal success with DECLINE, this nuanced look at a patchwork family of punks banded together against their bad parents + shitty authority figures is made even radder by hammering live sets from SoCal hardcore squads D.I. and TSOL. Fuck the world.

title: A Man Escaped
description: “On one side, thick walls, bars, soldiers, weapons. On the other, one lone man, unarmed, doomed from the start.” In minimalist Robert Bresson’s 1956 film, a French Resistance fighter attempts escape from a German military prison against impossible odds. While the title of the film seems to say it all, it belies the film’s gripping tension and near-silent sequences of harrowing engineering feats, unbelievable patience, and human resilience, all performed with placid determination by François Leterrier as he embodies lieutenant Fontaine, a proxy for André Devigny, whose life Bresson loosely adapted for the screen from his 1956 memoir.

title: The Informer (1935)             / Air Mail
description: Gypo Nolan stumbles through a foggy Irish night, his brain pickled in whiskey and his soul tormented by shame and fear. Gypo is an informer, a turncoat who betrayed his friend to the British police for 20 pounds. Now he can’t spend the money fast enough – nor can he run from his treachery fast enough – as he brawls, brags, swaggers and lies his way toward his fate. John Ford earned his first Best Director Academy Award, and star Victor McLaglen took home a Best Actor statuette for this searing four-time Oscar winner set in 1922 Dublin. Timely in its exploration of the tortured netherworld of human guilt, The Informer is filmmaking for the ages. (Warner Bros)

description: A daredevil driver is determined to compete in Redline, the most popular race in the galaxy. The race only occurs every five years, but in order to participate he must overcome the mafia, the government and even love.

The story transports her from the hospital into the exotic landscapes of her imagination.

title: The Third Man on 35mm
description: Join us for Carol Reed’s slick masterpiece of thrilling double-crosses, doomed love, and startling philosophy. Holly Martins, an author of pulp Westerns, arrives in postwar Vienna as a guest of his childhood chum Harry Lime, only to learn he has recently died. Martins stays around to investigate the death and finds everything isn’t what it seems. Joseph Cotton is the perfect patsy, Alida Valli is the gorgeous mystery, and Orson Welles is the smooth-talking devil twisting the rules to suit his own fortune. Often regarded as one of the best films of all time from the stunning cinematography, to the performances, to Welles’ adlibbed monologue on the Medicis and cuckoo clocks, The Third Man is every bit as good as the hype.

title: Midnight Run             / 48 Hrs.
description: The odd couple classic! Robert De Niro is a tough ex-cop tasked with finding Charles Grodin, a mild-mannered mob accountant who’s skipped bail and on the lam. But what was supposed to be a simple Midnight Run turns into a comedic, action-packed cross country chase where he’ll have to get the FBI off his case, the mob off his trail, and Grodin off his back!

title: Fairfax Film Festival: Revelations of Divine Love
description: Between pandemics, people’s revolts and male institutions, this period film cheekily combines fantastic psychedelia and handmade sets. Inspired by the life story of Julian of Norwich, a 14th-century mystic and the first woman to write a book in English.

title: ALL THAT HEAVEN ALLOWS
description: Jane Wyman, a lonely widow with two spoiled, almost grown children (William Reynolds, Gloria Talbot) as well as a circle of snobbish, upper-middle-class friends, suddenly finds herself falling in love with her gardener (Rock Hudson). Director Douglas Sirk examines the curious cultural barriers we set up for ourselves regarding love, skewering age and class differences in the process as well as championing fearless independence of the individual spirit – something that was not so common in the 1950s. One of the most subversive love stories of 20th-century cinema and a prime inspiration for Todd Haynes’ acclaimed FAR FROM HEAVEN.

title: In the Cut
description: Jane Campion’s gritty erotic thriller stars Meg Ryan as Frannie Avery, a seemingly apathetic writer and English teacher who finds solace in her daydream of language and literature. At a bar near her apartment, Frannie accidentally witnesses a sexual encounter between a woman and a man whose face she cannot recall. The woman is later found dismembered, spurring a visit from a detective who quickly becomes Frannie’s infatuation. Paralleling the desolate ambience of the urban landscape is Frannie’s facade, until her suppressed emotions trigger outbursts that may lead her straight into the path of a serial killer of women.

title: Taxi Driver
description: Martin Scorsese directs Paul Schrader’s searing script about alienation and desperation, following a shattered nightcrawler haunting the neon-lit streets of seedy ‘70s NYC as a nightshift Taxi Driver as he hurtles towards his imagined destiny. The gritty and hard-hitting masterpiece features an all-time great performance from Robert De Niro and scored the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival for the director.

title: ERASERHEAD
description: Put-upon Everyman Henry (Jack Nance) shambles resignedly through a dark, industrial-urban landscape. When he joins Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) in a nightmare parody of working-class connubial bliss, we soon realize there is no return ticket from this descent down the rabbit hole. “May be the greatest debut by an American director after CITIZEN KANE.” – Jeffrey M. Anderson, Combustible Celluloid.

title: Ice Cream Man
description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Two hitmen out to retrieve a suitcase stolen. An aging boxer paid to lose his next fight. A couple of young lovers and small-time thieves who decide they need a change of venue. Their lives are woven together in the exhilarating Pulp Fiction . Quentin Tarantino’s Palme d’Or-winning classic is packed with electric dialogue, potent pop-culture touchstones, and an unforgettable ensemble cast. You won’t know the facts until you’ve seen the fiction.

title: THE SIXTH DAY
description: This singularly arresting adaptation of a novel by renowned writer Andrée Chedid casts French pop star Dalida (in her final screen performance) as a married washerwoman trying to save the life of her stricken grandson in the midst of the 1947 cholera outbreak in Cairo, while simultaneously navigating the romantic advances of a charming, Gene Kelly–obsessed young organ grinder (Mohsen Mohieddin).

title: Jackass: Best and Last
description: Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, jackass: best and last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you’ve come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years. So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you’ll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.

title: The Weird Kidz
description: Three friends, 12-year-old boys Dug, Mel, and Fatt, go camping in the desert with Dug’s older brother Wyatt and his girlfriend Mary. When the group stops at a gas station, the owner Duana tells them about The Night Child, a creature she claims lives in the desert and took her younger brother twenty-five years ago. They quickly dismiss the story as an old urban legend, but once they arrive in the desert and set up camp, things get weird.

title: Doughboys Present POPEYE
description: Hosts and longtime frenemies Mike Mitchell and Nick Wiger review chain restaurants and bicker about absolutely everything on the iHeartRadio award-winning Best Food Podcast, Doughboys .

title: CLOSE ENCOUNTERS OF THE THIRD KIND in 70mm
description: Richard Dreyfuss stars as cable worker Roy Neary, who experiences a close encounter of the first kind – witnessing UFOs soaring across the sky. Meanwhile, government agents have close encounters of the second kind – discovering physical evidence of extraterrestrial visitors in the form of a lost fighter aircraft from World War II and a stranded military ship that disappeared decades earlier only to suddenly reappear in an unusual place. Roy and the agents follow the clues that have drawn them to reach a site where they will have a close encounter of the third kind – contact.

title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
description: The con is on with Frank Oz’s masterful dark comedy classic with absolute legends Steve Martin and Michael Caine! At a luscious coastal resort two expert con men go head to head and toe to toe in a match to see who can swindle an heiress out of her money and claim the resort for their own private hunting ground. Steve Martin turns on one of his most ridiculous performances against the suave and debonaire coolness always exuded by Michael Caine resulting in 24 carat comedy gold! Bring your best frenemy to ease the tension through uproarious laughter!

title: Basic Instinct
description: Hardboiled San Francisco detective Nick Curran (Michael Douglas) is assigned to the case of a murdered rock star and gets in over his head when he meets the victim’s lover, Catherine Tramell (Sharon Stone). A crime novelist whose latest work mirrors Curran’s case, and past relationships with violent people, Catherine becomes the prime suspect. Confronted by Tramell’s smoldering sensuality and mysterious past, Curran struggles to maintain his professionalism and not give into his carnal instincts. Paul Verhoeven’s erotic thriller made a huge impact, serving as a pop-culture reference for many years and defining the genre for the 1990s. The recipient of Academy Award nominations for editing (Frank J. Urioste) and Jerry Goldsmith’s original score, Basic Instinct, originally edited for sexual and violent content, has been restored in 4K and is now available in Verhoeven’s original, uncut version.

title: DO THE RIGHT THING
description: Spike Lee’s masterpiece DO THE RIGHT THING revolves around the comings and goings at Sal’s Famous Pizzeria on the hottest summer day in Bedford-Stuyvesant. Shot with an almost all-black crew, the film stars Lee as the hyperactive Mookie, with terrific support from Danny Aiello as Sal, Ossie Davis as Da Mayor, Giancarlo Esposito as Buggin’ Out, John Turturro as Pino and Samuel L. Jackson as Mister Señor Love Daddy. The film also features then-newcomer Rosie Perez, Ruby Dee, Bill Nunn and Joie Lee. With music by Public Enemy.

title: Taxi Driver
description: Martin Scorsese directs Paul Schrader’s searing script about alienation and desperation, following a shattered nightcrawler haunting the neon-lit streets of seedy ‘70s NYC as a nightshift Taxi Driver as he hurtles towards his imagined destiny. The gritty and hard-hitting masterpiece features an all-time great performance from Robert De Niro and scored the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival for the director.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
description: Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, jackass: best and last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you’ve come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years. So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you’ll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.

title: On the Silver Globe
description: A small group of cosmic explorers, including a woman, leaves Earth to start a new civilization. They do not realize that within themselves they carry the end of their own dream. They die one by one, while their children revert to a primitive native culture, creating new myths and a new god.

title: Breakin’ 2: Electric Boogaloo
description: A sequel that is best remembered for its subtitle, this 80s breakdancing cult classic is about to turn your Friday night into the ultimate 80s dance off! The best breakdancers on the block are poppin’ and lockin’ their way to good karma when they use their powers of dance to take on a greedy developer that threatens their beloved community center with strip-mallification. The fashion, the dance moves, the 80s cheese, the Cannon Films moxie, it’s all in such abundance, you’ll be doing head-spins on the way back to your car! So bring your crew, pop on your knee pads, and get ready for the ultimate in 80s dance cinema!

title: Three Wise Girls
description: Fed up with her tiny hometown, the lovely Cassie Barnes packs up and splits for New York City, where she rooms with her pal Dot. Cassie takes a series of disappointing jobs before her friend Gladys gets her a modeling gig. Then Cassie begins a romance with Jerry , who initially seems like the perfect man. Unfortunately, it turns out that he's married. He tries to tell Cassie that his marriage is already ending, but she's not convinced.

title: Cartoon Club
description: Calling all animation aficionados! Join us for a celebration of the art and history of one of our favorite mediums with our monthly Cartoon Club! Enjoy a feature-length assemblage of classic shorts, including rare gems unearthed from the vaults and other animated antics lovingly assembled from our large archive of film treasures.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
description: Johnny Knoxville and the gang return for one final fling at the big screen. Featuring all-new stunts and stupidity along with the greatest hits and biggest laughs from the past, jackass: best and last is a joyously raucous celebration of all the mischievous camaraderie that you’ve come to love and expect from these idiots over the past 25 years. So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you’ll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.

title: Harriet the Spy
description: The first motion picture produced by Nickelodeon is also Bronwen Hughes’s feature film directorial debut, starring Michelle Trachtenberg as a 12-year-old Harriet Welsch, who devotes her time spying on everyone and recording her discreet detective work in a “PRIVATE” notebook. When those secrets get exposed, Harriet finds her entire class against her, including her two best friends. This sweet drama boldly and candidly surveys the bittersweet pre-teen years as an exploration of self, complementing the confusion that marks this transitional phase with Harriet’s unapologetic, cheeky spirit, letting her fight her own battles and attain redemption.

title: Ice Cream Man
description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

title: Cannibal Holocaust
description: An anthropologist ventures to South America in search of a group who went missing while filming a documentary about cannibal tribes. And when he finds their lost footage, it will contain the shocking truth about their gruesome fate. The most controversial movie ever made has lost none of its unflinching power, a cruel cinematic landmark featuring special effects so realistic that director Ruggero Deodato was arrested on suspicion of murder.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
description: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Vidiots is purrfectly enthralled to bring back the cutest kitty compilation ever! CatVideoFest is a compilation reel of the latest and best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and classic internet powerhouses. CatVideoFest is a joyous communal experience, only available in theaters, and raises money for cats in need through partnerships with local cat charities, animal welfare organizations, and shelters to best serve cats in the area.

title: MAGNIFICENT OBSESSION
description: Reckless rich playboy, played by the great Rock Hudson in his breakthrough role, commits maritime manslaughter that ends the life of the town’s beloved local doctor. Douglas Sirk’s delirious Technicolor melodrama weaves its way through wild twists, turns, trials, tribulations, the American subconscious and the sudsy and spiritual journey to make right what can never be undone.

title: School of Rock
description: In the role he was born to play, Jack Black is Dewey Finn, a slacker guitar player still holding on to the dream of being a rock star. Due to a mix-up (and a low-level con), the wildly unqualified Dewey ends up substitute teacher in a prestigious elementary school. He recruits the bored prep school kids to form a new band, so these talented kids can rock the battle of the bands like it’s never been rocked before. This hilariously quoteable contemporary classic made Jack Black a superstar. And of course, it’s got a killer rock n rock soundtrack featuring songs from Led Zeppelin, Cream, T. Rex and the Black Keys, not to mention the original anthems performed by the kids themselves. Let’s get rockin!

title: Woodstock on 35mm
description: We got you front row passes to the most legendary concert in American history – and you get to enjoy the whole thing in the air conditioning! An intimate look at the Woodstock Music & Art Festival held in Bethel, NY in 1969, from preparation through cleanup, with historic access to insiders, blistering concert footage, and portraits of the concertgoers; negative and positive aspects are shown, from drug use by performers to naked fans sliding in the mud, from the collapse of the fences by the unexpected hordes to the surreal arrival of National Guard helicopters with food and medical assistance for the impromptu city of 500,000. Join in on the musical mayhem on our big screen in glorious celluloid!

title: SHERLOCK JR. / "The Electric House" / "The Scarecrow"
description: Buster plays a movie projectionist who daydreams himself into the movies he is showing and merges with the figures and the backgrounds on the screen. While dreaming he is Conan Doyle’s master detective, he snoops out brilliant discoveries.

title: GET SHORTY
description: Golden Globe winner John Travolta stars with Gene Hackman, Danny DeVito and Rene Russo in this wildly popular comedy of a gangster who turns into a big-time producer after he travels to Hollywood to collect a debt.

title: Bouchra
description: Join us in the microcinema for one of the most unique animated feature films of recent history – Maeriem Bennani’s intensely personal, singular, and genuine Bouchra . Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression. Juxtaposing decidedly absurd animation choices with the realism of her characters and dialogue, Bennani creates an asbolutely unique vision of artistry and queer identity.

title: Final Fantasy: The Spirits Within
description: Brain Dead Studios presents FINAL FANTASY: THE SPIRITS WITHIN , preceded by a special seminar presented by filmmaker Heather Landsman exploring the film’s ambitious creation, groundbreaking technology, and infamous legacy.

title: ALIENS in 70mm
description: Fifty-seven years after surviving an apocalyptic attack aboard her space vessel by merciless space creatures, Officer Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) awakens from hyper-sleep and tries to warn anyone who will listen about the predators. Although she is ignored at first, when contact with colonists on a planet thought safe is suddenly lost, Ripley and a military team are sent to confront the aliens.

title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
description: Vidiots is celebrating the 100th birthday of one of the greatest legends of comedy and cinema – the incomparable Mel Brooks – with a stupid fun screening of his ridiculous comedy classic Robin Hood: Men in Tights!

title: Taxi Driver
description: Martin Scorsese directs Paul Schrader’s searing script about alienation and desperation, following a shattered nightcrawler haunting the neon-lit streets of seedy ‘70s NYC as a nightshift Taxi Driver as he hurtles towards his imagined destiny. The gritty and hard-hitting masterpiece features an all-time great performance from Robert De Niro and scored the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival for the director.

title: Twin Peaks: The Original Mystery – Episodes 7 + 8
description: She’s dead… wrapped in plastic. If your summer plans call for an enigmatic journey to the Pacific Northwest and a small sleepy burg called Twin Peaks , have we got news for you! Go back to the beginning of David Lynch and Mark Frost’s game-changing television phenomenon with a special theatrical screening of the first two episodes of this landmark series on our beautiful big screen. When the homecoming queen washes ashore shrouded in a plastic coccoon, this small town is thrown into tragedy and panic. Luckily, the FBI’s most intriguing special agent, Dale Cooper, is on the case and vows to unravel this enduring mystery that extends beyond Twin Peaks and into the dark recesses of this universe and beyond. Whether you’re starting the show for the first time, or you’re revisiting for your twentieth, there’s nothing like seeing this dark, clever, mystical, metaphysical, and offbeat masterpiece at Vidiots!

title: Christine
description: A meeting of two of the greatest minds in horror, this vehicular monster movie combines the sentient machines of Stephen King with the uneasy vibes of John Carpenter for an 80s horror classic in high gear. Nerdy high schooler Arnie Cunningham falls for Christine, a rusty 1958 Plymouth Fury, and becomes obsessed with restoring the classic automobile to her former glory. As the car changes, so does Arnie, whose newfound confidence turns to arrogance behind the wheel of his exotic beauty. Arnie’s girlfriend Leigh and best friend Dennis reach out to him, only to be met by a Fury like no other. Featuring Vidiots’ forever legend Harry Dean Stanton as a wisened, chain-smoking police detective trying to solve a string of mysterious homicides that appear to be the work of a motorpsycho.

title: Three Wise Girls

Cassie takes a series of disappointing jobs before her friend Gladys gets her a modeling gig. Then Cassie begins a romance with Jerry , who initially seems like the perfect man. Unfortunately, it turns out that he's married. He tries to tell Cassie that his marriage is already ending, but she's not convinced.

title: Macon Blair Presents THE TRAIN
description: This true story of wartime valor stars Burt Lancaster as a French railway inspector who goes up against the Nazis in order to prevent a trainload of France’s most treasured paintings from being stolen. Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau co-star in this suspense-filled and sophisticated action film from John Frankenheimer.

title: CatVideoFest 2026
description: Our fuzzy overlords return to the big screen! Vidiots is purrfectly enthralled to bring back the cutest kitty compilation ever! CatVideoFest is a compilation reel of the latest and best cat videos culled from countless hours of unique submissions and sourced animations, music videos, and classic internet powerhouses. CatVideoFest is a joyous communal experience, only available in theaters, and raises money for cats in need through partnerships with local cat charities, animal welfare organizations, and shelters to best serve cats in the area.

title: The Thin Red Line
description: Terrence Malick adapted James Jones’s 1962 novel, inspired by the author’s experiences serving in World War II’s Guadalcanal campaign, for his first film since his 1978 classic Days of Heaven . Malick assembled an all-star cast (including George Clooney, Nick Nolte and John Travolta) for his unusually contemplative war epic, which received seven Oscar nominations including Directing, Adapted Screenplay (both for Malick) and Best Picture. Nominated composer Hans Zimmer spent nine months working on his evocative score, which he termed the most challenging assignment of his career.

title: School of Rock

Rex and the Black Keys, not to mention the original anthems performed by the kids themselves. Let’s get rockin!

title: Bunny Lake is Missing
description: One of the most important auteurs of the 20th century cinema, Otto Preminger is known for his bold exploration of themes challenging the societal norms of his era. Carol Lynley, in an exceptional performance, portrays Ann Lake, a mother recently moved to London from New York with her 4-year-old daughter, Bunny. When Bunny vanishes without a trace, as if she never existed in the first place, Superintendent Newhouse excavates disturbing truths behind a family’s refined façade. Preminger finesses a subtle construction of atmospheric tension, amplified with a crisp, black-and-white cinematography that articulates Ann’s psychological isolation and creates an eerie, claustrophobic ambience.

title: PROJECT HAIL MARY in 70mm
description: Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

title: THE HOLE
description: Set just prior to the start of the 21st century, this vaguely futuristic story follows two residents of a quickly crumbling building who refuse to leave their homes in spite of a virus that has forced the evacuation of the area. As rain pours down relentlessly, a single man is stuck with an unfinished plumbing job and a hole in his floor. This results in a very odd relationship with the woman who lives below him. Combining deadpan humor with an austere view of loneliness and a couple of unexpected musical numbers, Tsai Ming-Liang crafted one of the most original films of the 1990s.

title: Rashomon
description: One of the most influential movies ever made, Rashomon is an enduring masterpiece that served as the big breakthrough for both legendary director Akira Kurosawa and charismatic star Toshirō Mifune, and introduced a radical new idea to cinema: telling the same story multiple times through the POV of different characters. Set in 11th century Kyoto, the plot centers on a grisly crime — a samurai is murdered and his wife assaulted by a bandit — that’s depicted via a series of flashbacks in which the participants each give their version of what happened. When their stories fail to match up, it’s left to the viewer to determine where exactly the truth lies. The first Japanese movie to win the Oscar for Best Foreign Language Film, this shapeshifting thriller has inspired countless imitators and even coined a psychological phenomenon called the “Rashomon Effect.”

title: Bouchra
description: Join us in the microcinema for one of the most unique animated feature films of recent history – Maeriem Bennani’s intensely personal, singular, and genuine Bouchra . Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. title: Elle
description: Michèle (Isabelle Huppert), the head of a popular video game company, is attacked in her home by a masked assailant. Unaware of her attacker’s identity and suspicious of the men in her life, she begins to track down the criminal herself, stepping into a dangerous game of cat and mouse. Based on the award-winning novel Oh... by Philippe Djian and propelled by Huppert’s Oscar-nominated performance, Paul Verhoeven’s first French-language film was France’s official submission for International Feature Film for the 89th Academy Awards.

The gritty and hard-hitting masterpiece features an all-time great performance from Robert De Niro and scored the Palme d’Or at the Cannes Film Festival for the director.

title: Alice Coltrane: Eternity’s Pillar
description: Originally broadcast on late-night Los Angeles television between 1985 and 1988, Eternity’s Pillar is Alice Coltrane’s rarely seen series blending devotional music, meditation, and spiritual teachings. This special screening presents four newly restored episodes from the Coltrane archive, offering a rare glimpse into the visionary artist’s extraordinary creative and spiritual practice.

title: Can’t Hardly Wait
description: Vidiots can’t wait to party with Writer/Directors Deborah Kaplan and Harry Elfont at a special screening of their quintessential 90s teen classic Can’t Hardly Wait, and you’re invited!

So, grab your dumb little buddies, raise your glasses, and come experience the cinematic event that promises to be the last time you’ll ever laugh this hard in a theatre.

title: Cinematic Void Presents TAPEHEADS
description: Recently fired security guards Ivan and Josh are sure they’ve found their calling: the world of music videos. But in trying to resuscitate the career of a legendary soul duo they begin careening through an outrageous underworld.

title: The Prestige
description: Two illusionists compete at the turn of the 20th century to create history’s greatest magic trick in this time-fracturing thriller from director/co-writer Christopher Nolan. Based on the 1995 novel by Christopher Priest, the film earned Oscar nominations for its cinematography (Wally Pfister) and art direction (Nathan Crowley, Julie Ochipinti), which cleverly used surviving Los Angeles picture palaces as key locations. The stellar cast includes Hugh Jackman and Christian Bale as the rivals, Michael Caine as their mentor, Scarlett Johansson and Rebecca Hall as the women in their lives, and a memorable cameo from David Bowie as the inventor Nikola Tesla.

description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results. (The Horror Section)

title: Sound and Fury: JAWBREAKER: Anti-Cimex Documentary w/ Q+A
description: Sound and Fury presents of Jawbreaker: an Anti-Cimex Documentary with Q+A by Director Tomas Haglund moderated by Zed Cutsinger of So You Did A Thing Podcast

title: LOCKJAW
description: Six weeks after a drunk driving accident that left her jaw wired shut, Rayna tries to have a fun night out with her friends. Over the course of a wild night, she strains existing relationships and makes new enemies. conflicts.

title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
description: Featuring a conversation with filmmaker Sasha Waters after the August 12th screening!

title: To Be or Not To Be
description: A Shakespearean actor reluctantly joins a Resistance plot against the Nazis in 1939 Warsaw in this daring comedy directed by two-time Oscar nominee Ernst Lubitsch ( Heaven Can Wait, 1943). Comedy legend Jack Benny had his greatest screen role as the pompous ham Joseph Tura, and Oscar nominee Carole Lombard ( My Man Godfrey , 1936) was his expert match as his actress wife, Maria, her final film role before her death weeks before the film’s release. Finding the perfect balance between wartime tension and hilarious farce, Lubitsch’s classic— filmed right as the U.S. entered World War II— was remade in 1983, with Mel Brooks and Anne Bancroft as the couple.

title: Manhunter: The Final Cut
description: Before Silence of the Lambs , Michael Mann first introduced the cinema world to infamous cannibal Hannibal Lecter in this sizzling and stylish thriller. FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the “Tooth Fairy”. Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer — and cannibal — Dr. Hannibal Lecktor (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecktor and an interfering journalist.

title: My Dinner with Andre             / Vanya on 42nd Street
description: In this captivating and philosophical film directed by Louis Malle, actor and playwright Wallace Shawn sits down with his friend the theater director André Gregory at a restaurant on New York’s Upper West Side, and the pair proceed through an alternately whimsical and despairing confessional about love, death, money, and all the superstition in between. Playing variations on their own New York–honed personas, Shawn and Gregory, who also cowrote the screenplay, dive in with introspective intellectual gusto, and Malle captures it all with a delicate, artful detachment. A fascinating freeze-frame of cosmopolitan culture, My Dinner with André remains a unique work in cinema history. (Janus Films)

title: The Dreamers
description: When Isabelle and Theo invite Matthew to stay with them, what begins as a casual friendship ripens into a sensual voyage of discovery and desire in which nothing is off limits and everything is possible.

title: TWIN PEAKS: THE RETURN Parts 17 & 18
description: The American Cinematheque is a member-donor-volunteer supported 501(c)(3) non-profit arts organization whose mission is to celebrate the experience of cinema.

title: Sound and Fury presents HOLE DWELLER, DIPLODOCUS & GARGOYLE
Fatal Attraction
description: Adrian Lyne’s groundbreaking 1987 erotic thriller, which garnered six Oscar nominations, contributed to the phenomenal boom of this subgenre, and it remains iconic and timeless. Glenn Close is compelling in her portrayal of Alex, a book editor who has an affair with Dan (Michael Douglas), a happily married attorney whose life becomes an unbearable torture after the tryst. Passion turns into obsession; Alex not only terrorizes Dan but also his wife and young daughter. Close’s deep dive into Alex’s psychological state, exhibited in the extreme measures she takes to possess Dan, is manifested in an intense performance,and the chemistry she shares with Douglas’s riveting Dan creates simultaneously repulsive and magnetic dynamics between them.
